summary.text: Jarrett Coleman is a Republican state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 16, which serves Lehigh and Bucks counties, since his election in November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He is an airline pilot and chairs the Senate Intergovernmental Operations Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Mark Pinsley, the Lehigh County Controller, as his opponent.

paragraphs.text: Jarrett Coleman is a ninth-generation Pennsylvanian who was born and raised in the Lehigh Valley, according to his official biography.
He holds a Bachelor of Science in Aeronautics and a Master of Business Administration from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University.
He was previously elected to the Parkland School Board in Lehigh County.

Coleman serves as vice chair of the Senate Finance Committee and as a member of the Community, Economic and Recreational Development; Education; Game and Fisheries; Urban Affairs and Housing; and Appropriations committees.
He lives with his wife, Katie, and their three children.
